observations.selector_observation: The current Essential selector exposes Eco-G 120 manual 6-speed, but the target Eco-G 100 4x2 manual state could not be selected.
The current Expression selector exposes Eco-G 120 manual, Eco-G 120 automatic, Mild Hybrid 140, Tribid 150 4x4 and Hybrid 155; Eco-G 100 4x2 manual is not selectable.
Extreme is selectable, but Eco-G 100 is not exposed as an engine option; the available list includes Eco-G 120 manual, Eco-G 120 automatic, Mild Hybrid 140, Tribid 150 4x4 and Hybrid 155.

negative_evidence_rule: These observations do not establish inactivity or colour incompatibility for the target Eco-G 100 configurations. They only record that the exact target selector state could not be reproduced in the current configurator session.
note: No colour values from the fallback Eco-G 120 states are promoted to the Eco-G 100 targets. Journey Eco-G 100 was not captured in this batch.
